from pathlib import Path

target='DEV-PRED-AUTOBUILD-DIAG-20260930-E001'
roots=[
    Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor',
    Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-command-bus',
    Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor',
]
print('TARGET='+target)
found=0
for root in roots:
    print('ROOT='+str(root))
    if not root.exists():
        print('ROOT_MISSING')
        continue
    for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
        if target not in p.name and target not in str(p):
            continue
        found += 1
        print('PATH='+str(p))
        if p.is_file():
            try:
                raw=p.read_text(errors='replace')
            except Exception as e:
                print('READ_ERROR='+repr(e))
                continue
            print(raw[-12000:])
print('FOUND='+str(found))
